items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Because Lily used to tell me all the time. Joe said, I got to go home to that chicken.

ctx.x: That's what I heard him like. He was a big joker.

If you wasn't a kid out there, don't stop at Joe. Because he could kid you and he'd make you so mad. And he never got mad. But he just liked a kid. He liked a kid. And everything was good natured with him. He wasn't hardly serious with anything. But he loved his home. He did. He loved his home. He was a man that didn't stay out all night. Gallivanting around. Because Lily used to tell me all the time. Joe said, I got to go home to that chicken. He called me the chicken all the time. He says, I got to go home to…
Somebody told me about that. He used to like that sugar water. Just put sugar in water.
